resources.name: GULP (General Utility Lattice Program)

access.notes: Open-source classical simulation code, version 5.x or later

resources.notes: Run GULP at the command line; install and compile if needed.

resources.name: Na4SiO4 crystal structure (ICSD CollCode62594 or published lattice parameters)

access.notes: CIF file for Na4SiO4; also obtainable from the published lattice parameters (a=5.58, b=5.58, c=8.39 Å, α=80.92°, β=71.84°, γ=67.44°, space group P-1) and atomic coordinates given in Baur et al. (Monatshefte Chem. 1986).

resources.name: Buckingham potential parameters for host Na4SiO4

access.notes: Parameters exactly as in Table 1 of the paper: Na-O: A=1497.830598 eV, ρ=0.287483 Å, C=0.0; Si-O: A=1283.91 eV, ρ=0.32052 Å, C=10.66; O-O: A=22764.30 eV, ρ=0.1490 Å, C=27.88; with shell charges and spring constants as given. These are input numbers for the GULP input file, not gold values.

resources.notes: The agent must construct a GULP library or input file containing these parameters.

resources.name: Buckingham potential parameters for dopants

access.notes: Supplementary Table S1 from the paper; contains parameters for Li, K, Rb, Al, Ga, In, Sc, Y, Gd, Ge, Sn, Ti, Ce.

resources.notes: The agent must extract the numerical values from the supplementary PDF table.
